status: improved density but still not visually acceptable

observations.defect: More ordinary building mass now exists on the market corridor, but the right side still resolves mostly as side walls over unsupported blue ground rather than a finished street edge.
The added pass-by buildings reduce the emptiness slightly, yet the corridor still falls away into void and lacks enclosing frontage on the near-right travel side.
The civic approach remains dominated by a broad blank wall mass; the filler pass did not yet create a believable street-facing frontage toward this view.
The central gap is tighter than before, but the foreground remains a large unsupported blue-ground void with shell-like enclosure.
Additional filler blocks exist, but this view still reads as repeated blank massing without enough finished street frontage, pavement continuity or plot backing.

nextNeed: Author street-facing filler parcels rather than only cloned shell stacks, especially on the camera-right side of Market Road and the main face of Civic Street.
Add complete ground support around the new buildings so pavements, curbs and plots do not terminate into blue voids.
Use more varied frontage orientation and side-return composition so the district reads as Lagos street fabric instead of repeated blank wall blocks.
